interpretation: GPU physics runs through Newton SourceModelSolverMuJoCo/MuJoCo Warp CUDA; Isaac display consumes measured states in a separate process and never steps physics.
Same-model CPU references are timing and physical comparison points, not Newton GPU throughput evidence.
Per-phase RTF matters. Headless and GUI session phase rows are both retained; GUI phase may dip below1 even when overall loop is faster than realtime.
Profile/contact-witness runs are instrumented and excluded from speed ranking.
Selected models change joint representation and fruit convex approximation; same source CAD visuals are not proof of unchanged dynamics or real-plant calibration.
Released joint count, retained fruit traction, contact force and collection/whole-truss harvest success are different claims.
